title: InstantiateMsg
description: Message for instantiating the IBC Eureka adapter contract

admins.description: The config admins who can update the config and manage denoms/depositors/executors

eureka_fee_receiver.description: Address on Cosmos Hub that receives the IBC Eureka relayer fee

ibc_transfer_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout, in seconds, to be used when building IBC Eureka transfer messages

initial_allowed_destination_addresses.description: Initial allowed EVM destination addresses (can be empty array)

initial_depositors.description: Initial depositors to register during instantiation (can be empty array)

initial_executors.description: Initial executors who can perform operations (can be empty array)

skip_swap_entry_point_contract.description: Address of the Skip swap entry-point contract on Cosmos Hub

source_channel.description: IBC Eureka source channel ID used for bridging to the destination chain

DepositorCapabilities.description: Depositor capabilities for the IBC Eureka adapter

can_withdraw.description: Whether this depositor can withdraw funds
